description: This Java interface defines a contract for aggregating multiple authentication failure reasons into a single exception, specifically a DittoRuntimeException. It is part of a security/authentication package in an Eclipse Ditto gateway service.

classes.name: AuthenticationFailureAggregator
classes.description: A functional interface for aggregating authentication failure reasons into a single exception.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Combines failure reasons from a list of AuthenticationResult objects into a single DittoRuntimeException. It ignores failure reasons that are not of type DittoRuntimeException or lack a description.
